critical_code_review_comments: Fix in /app/frontend/src/lib/academicYear.jsx is correct: setYear now always calls setApiYear(val) with the raw 'all' sentinel or the year string, and api.js request interceptor only injects ?year when selectedYear && selectedYear !== 'all'. initialYear() reads the stored value directly, so 'all' is preserved across reloads.
Minor (pre-existing, not blocking): AcademicYearSelect passes v to setYear untouched; the ternary `v === 'all' ? 'all' : v` is a no-op. Harmless.
seed_data_creation: None. No test data created. Reset selector to 'All years' at end of test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 74's HIGH bug is fully resolved. Frontend Academic Year selector now correctly persists 'all' sentinel (localStorage='all'), suppresses ?year= param on API GETs, and survives manual browser refresh. Specific-year selection (2026) also verified end-to-end. No further action required on this feature.
rca of the issue: Original bug (iter_74): setYear('all') called setApiYear(null), which removed the localStorage key; on reload, initialYear() saw no stored value and defaulted back to CURRENT_YEAR (2026). Fix (iter_75, applied by main agent in academicYear.jsx): setYear always persists a value — either the year string or the literal 'all' — via setApiYear(val). api.js's request interceptor was already guarded with `selectedYear && selectedYear !== 'all'`, so the 'all' sentinel is stored but not injected. Verified in browser: localStorage='all' persists across reload and manual refresh, and no /api GET carries ?year=.
